notes: New Sheet > Lined up by grid: drawings can now be lined up with each other, with no other drawing to match. In Drawing to Match, choose "None: line the drawings up with each other" (it is chosen for you when no drawing holds the others, such as two halves of a floor). The new sheet takes the paper of the first drawing, at the biggest scale the whole plan fits, with every grid line and name across all the drawings. Edit Combined Drawing… works on it as on any combined drawing.
